{{Quote|You ever carry out an assault on an urban objective before?''"<br />"''Yes, N'dian. Heard of it?''"<br />"''I meant one where you had to leave the place pretty well intact, sir.|[[Clone commando/Legends|Clone commando]] [[Sev/Legends|Sev]] and Null-11|<ref name="TZ" />}}
In the [[22 BBY/Legends|first year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''fierce battle''' was fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[N'dian]]. During the battle, Republic [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Ordo Skirata|Null-11]] managed to [[Death/Legends|eliminate]] a group of Confederates hiding in one of N'dian's [[City/Legends|urban centers]], but had to virtually destroy the city in the process.

==The battle==
An intense battle was fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on the<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[N'dian]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the battle, the Republic dispatched<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Ordo Skirata|Null-11]], nicknamed "Ordo,"<ref name="TZ" /> to eradicate a collection of Confederates believed to be hiding in one of N'dian's [[City/Legends|urban centers]]. Ordo located and [[Death/Legends|eliminated]] the Confederates, but was forced to single-handedly obliterate most of the city in the process.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle on N'dian was first briefly mentioned in the [[Karen Traviss]] novel ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'', released on [[February 28]], [[2006]]. The events of the battle were later expanded upon in N'dian's entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', released [[December 9]], [[2008]].
